package projectauthoring

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
)

type IDGenerator interface{ NewID() string }
type Clock interface{ Now() time.Time }

type Commands struct {
	Flows    repository.ProjectAuthoringFlowRepository
	Students domainservice.ProjectAuthoringStudentService
	IDs      IDGenerator
	Clock    Clock
}

func (commands Commands) Create(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID, learningPathID, idempotencyKey string,
	request domain.ProjectAuthoringCreateRequestV1,
) (domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, bool, error) {
	if commands.Flows == nil || commands.Students == nil || commands.IDs == nil || commands.Clock == nil ||
		request.Schema != domain.ProjectAuthoringCreateSchemaV1 {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if stored, err := commands.Flows.GetProjectAuthoringFlowByKey(ctx, studentID, idempotencyKey); err == nil {
		expected, digestErr := domain.ProjectAuthoringDigest(struct {
			Schema         string `json:"schema"`
			StudentID      string `json:"student_id"`
			LearningPathID string `json:"learning_path_id"`
		}{domain.ProjectAuthoringCreateSchemaV1, studentID, learningPathID})
		if digestErr != nil || stored.LearningPathID != learningPathID || stored.RequestHash != expected {
			return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return stored, false, nil
	} else if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, false, err
	}
	profile, err := commands.Students.GetPlanningProfile(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, false, err
	}
	path, err := commands.Students.GetLearningPathPlanningState(ctx, studentID, learningPathID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, false, err
	}
	flow, err := domain.NewProjectAuthoringFlow(
		commands.IDs.NewID(), studentID, learningPathID, idempotencyKey, profile, path,
		commands.Clock.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, false, err
	}
	stored, created, err := commands.Flows.CreateOrGetProjectAuthoringFlow(ctx, flow)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, false, err
	}
	if !sameProjectAuthoringSnapshot(stored, flow) {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return stored, created, nil
}

func (commands Commands) Get(ctx context.Context, studentID, flowID string) (domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, error) {
	if commands.Flows == nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return commands.Flows.GetProjectAuthoringFlow(ctx, studentID, flowID)
}

// GetCurrent recovers the non-failed flow for exactly the current owner snapshot.
// It deliberately derives provenance from fresh Student reads rather than using a
// locator or a latest-flow query, so stale projects can never be returned.
func (commands Commands) GetCurrent(ctx context.Context, studentID, learningPathID string) (domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, error) {
	if commands.Flows == nil || commands.Students == nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	profile, err := commands.Students.GetPlanningProfile(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	path, err := commands.Students.GetLearningPathPlanningState(ctx, studentID, learningPathID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateCurrentProjectAuthoringOwnerState(profile, path); err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	pathDigest, err := domain.ProjectPathSnapshotDigest(path)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	profileDigest, err := domain.ProjectAuthoringProfileDigest(profile)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	return commands.Flows.GetCurrentProjectAuthoringFlow(
		ctx, studentID, learningPathID, path.PathVersion, pathDigest, profile.OnboardingVersion, profileDigest,
	)
}

func sameProjectAuthoringSnapshot(left, right domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow) bool {
	return left.RequestHash == right.RequestHash &&
		left.StudentID == right.StudentID &&
		left.LearningPathID == right.LearningPathID &&
		left.LearningPathVersion == right.LearningPathVersion &&
		left.PathSnapshotDigest == right.PathSnapshotDigest &&
		left.AuthoringProfileVersion == right.AuthoringProfileVersion &&
		left.AuthoringProfileDigest == right.AuthoringProfileDigest
}

func (commands Commands) Confirm(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID, flowID, idempotencyKey string,
	request domain.ProjectAuthoringConfirmRequestV1,
) (domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, error) {
	if commands.Flows == nil || commands.Students == nil || commands.Clock == nil ||
		request.Schema != domain.ProjectAuthoringConfirmSchemaV1 {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	flow, err := commands.Flows.GetProjectAuthoringFlow(ctx, studentID, flowID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	digest, err := domain.ProjectConfirmationDigest(flow)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	if flow.ConfirmationIdempotencyKey != "" {
		if flow.ConfirmationIdempotencyKey != idempotencyKey || flow.ConfirmationDigest != digest {
			return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return flow, nil
	}
	if flow.Status != domain.ProjectAuthoringProposed {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if err := commands.validateOwner(ctx, flow); err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	return commands.Flows.ConfirmProjectAuthoringFlow(
		ctx, studentID, flowID, idempotencyKey, digest,
		commands.Clock.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond),
	)
}

func (commands Commands) RequestPublication(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID, flowID, idempotencyKey string,
	request domain.ProjectAuthoringPublishRequestV1,
) (domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow, error) {
	if commands.Flows == nil || commands.Students == nil || commands.Clock == nil ||
		request.Schema != domain.ProjectAuthoringPublishSchemaV1 {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	flow, err := commands.Flows.GetProjectAuthoringFlow(ctx, studentID, flowID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	digest, err := domain.ProjectPublicationRequestDigest(flow)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	if flow.PublicationIdempotencyKey != "" {
		if flow.Status != domain.ProjectAuthoringPublished || flow.Publication == nil || domain.ValidateProjectPublicationReceipt(*flow.Publication, flow) != nil {
			return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		if flow.PublicationIdempotencyKey != idempotencyKey || flow.PublicationRequestDigest != digest {
			return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return flow, nil
	}
	if flow.Status != domain.ProjectAuthoringReady {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if err := commands.validateOwner(ctx, flow); err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, err
	}
	// Generated and staged candidates have no Practice-owned acceptance proof.
	// Publication integration is deferred until that proof has a typed contract.
	return domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{}, domain.ErrConflict
}

func (commands Commands) validateOwner(ctx context.Context, flow domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow) error {
	profile, err := commands.Students.GetPlanningProfile(ctx, flow.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	path, err := commands.Students.GetLearningPathPlanningState(ctx, flow.StudentID, flow.LearningPathID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return domain.ValidateProjectOwnerSnapshot(flow, profile, path)
}
